title: National Climate Resilience Assessment for Algeria
temporal_coverage: Observed climate and infrastructure evidence through 2024; projections to 2081–2100.
methodology: IEA assessment combines climate observations, IPCC projections, INFORM hazard indicators and energy-system exposure analysis.
limitations: Most infrastructure examples concern energy assets; household vulnerability is not comprehensively mapped.

title: Inclusive insurance and risk financing in Algeria: Snapshot and way forward 2023
organization: United Nations Development Programme Insurance and Risk Finance Facility and UNDP Algeria
temporal_coverage: Hazard records range from historical periods through 2020; insurance and disaster-finance snapshot mainly covers 2019–2021.
methodology: The 23-page summary presents an inclusive-insurance and disaster-risk-finance country diagnostic and key hazard impacts.
limitations: Historical hazard and insurance data are dated, not a current local assessment.

title: Algeria: Selected Issues, Fiscal Reforms to Support Addressing Climate Change Challenges
temporal_coverage: IMF staff climate-risk and fiscal analysis completed in March 2024; includes projections through 2100 and policy simulations.
methodology: IMF staff assesses physical and fiscal climate risks and models policy options using the IMF-World Bank Climate Policy Assessment Tool.
limitations: Impact pathways and policy results are projections or model outputs; they do not establish observed displacement or violence.

title: Urban Natural Hazard Vulnerability Reduction Project: Technical Annex to the Memorandum of the President
temporal_coverage: Technical annex and proposed project design following the November 2001 Algiers flood.
methodology: Technical annex documents local vulnerability diagnoses, project components, institutional arrangements and intended emergency works.
limitations: This is a 2002 design-stage annex; proposed surveys, training and protections are not evidence of completed results.

title: Law No. 24-04 of 26 February 2024 on prevention, intervention and reduction of disaster risks
organization: Official Gazette of the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria
temporal_coverage: Statutory disaster-risk governance provisions published March 2024.
methodology: Official Gazette publishes the French translation of Law 24-04 and its disaster-risk governance requirements.
limitations: Statutory mandates do not establish whether local plans, training or warning systems operate effectively.
